query: Consider the Non-Disclosure Agreement between Dollar General and Portfolio Entity; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: Except as otherwise provided in this Agreement, Owner and Buyer agree that the covenants, warranties and representations contained herein shall survive the completion of the services and the termination of this Agreement.
rag_answer: Yes. The Agreement includes a survival provision. Section 9(c) states that, except as otherwise provided in the Agreement, the covenants, warranties, and representations contained in the Agreement shall survive the completion of the services and the termination of the Agreement.

judge.answer_summary: 回答指出协议包含 survival provision，并复述了 covenants、warranties 和 representations 在服务完成及协议终止后继续有效。
